objects.name: Detection technique coverage: linux-auditd-find-credentials-from-password-managers
objects.description: The following analytic detects suspicious attempts to find credentials stored in password managers, which may indicate an attacker's effort to retrieve sensitive login information. Password managers are often targeted by adversaries seeking to access stored passwords for further compromise or lateral movement within a network.
